events.title: World Health Organization Established
events.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) officially came into existence when its constitution took effect after ratification by 26 UN member states. It was established as the United Nations specialized agency for international public health.
events.significance: April 7 is now observed annually as World Health Day. The WHO has led global efforts such as the eradication of smallpox and coordinates responses to international health emergencies.

events.title: Start of the Rwandan Genocide
events.description: Following the plane crash that killed President Juvénal Habyarimana on April 6, Hutu extremist forces began a systematic campaign of mass killing of Tutsi and moderate Hutu in Rwanda. Roughly 800,000 people were killed over about 100 days.
events.significance: The genocide exposed the failure of the international community to intervene and led to the creation of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda and lasting reflection on the responsibility to protect.

events.title: First Long-Distance Demonstration of Television
events.description: Bell Telephone Laboratories and the U.S. Department of Commerce gave the first long-distance demonstration of television, transmitting images of Commerce Secretary Herbert Hoover from Washington, D.C. to an audience in New York City.
events.significance: The demonstration was an early milestone in the development of television as a mass communication medium that would transform news, entertainment, and culture.

events.title: Beethoven's Third Symphony 'Eroica' Premieres
events.description: Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, 'Eroica', was publicly premiered at the Theater an der Wien in Vienna.
events.significance: The symphony's unprecedented length, emotional scope, and structural innovation helped mark the transition from the Classical to the Romantic era in Western music.

events.title: Internet Engineering Begins with the First RFC
events.description: Steve Crocker published RFC 1, 'Host Software', documenting early design work on the ARPANET, the precursor to the modern internet.
events.significance: The Request for Comments series became the primary way internet standards and protocols are proposed and documented, shaping the open development of the internet.
